documents.title: Effect preference
documents.markdown: Luv prefers Effect 4 for the yumeoi domain layer. The team keeps Effect out of React components.

documents.title: Stack decision
documents.markdown: We decided to run ingest on Cloudflare Workflows. Chat will use GPT-5.6 Luna at high effort.

documents.title: M1 task
documents.markdown: Luv needs to ship M1 this week. The todo is wiring POST /ingest to IngestWorkflow.

documents.title: Teammates
documents.markdown: Luv works with Cursor agents on yumeoi. Sam reports to Luv on connector work.

documents.title: Kickoff
documents.markdown: The kickoff meeting is scheduled tomorrow at 10:00. Yesterday we reviewed the v0 plan.

documents.title: Editor
documents.markdown: Luv prefers dark mode in the editor at all times. Tabs are required in Biome output.

documents.title: Search
documents.markdown: We decided to use DO SQLite FTS5 for keyword search. Vectorize holds the embeddings.

documents.title: Gmail later
documents.markdown: We need to add the Gmail connector in M5. Skip attachments for v0.

documents.title: Auth
documents.markdown: API keys start with ym_ and are hashed in D1. MCP OAuth waits until M4.

documents.title: Embeddings
documents.markdown: Embeddings use Workers AI bge-m3 at 1024 dimensions. Namespaces are the user id.

documents.title: Rerank
documents.markdown: We decided to skip LLM rerank on raw search_memories. recall_context still reranks.

documents.title: Obsidian
documents.markdown: The Obsidian plugin should POST changed files with a contentHash. Vaults are local files.

documents.title: Notion poll
documents.markdown: Notion polling is scheduled every 10 minutes. Rate limit is about 3 requests per second.

documents.title: Single worker
documents.markdown: We decided to ship one Worker for UI, agents, MCP, and the API. Split later only if the bundle hits 10 MB.

documents.title: Luv and Sam
documents.markdown: Sam is a teammate on connectors. Luv works with Sam on the Notion markdown converter.

documents.title: Coffee
documents.markdown: Luv prefers oat milk in coffee. Meetings after 4pm are a hard no.

documents.title: Budget
documents.markdown: Each source has a daily token budget. Polling pauses when the budget is exceeded.

documents.title: Reindex
documents.markdown: We need to add a reindex command in M6. Delete-source must cascade through DO, Vectorize, and R2.

documents.title: Chat model
documents.markdown: Chat is pinned to gpt-5.6-luna. Escape hatch is Terra if citation quality is insufficient.

documents.title: Launch
documents.markdown: Public launch is scheduled for after Gmail verification. Yesterday we locked the v0 decisions.

documents.title: Citations
documents.markdown: Every chat answer should cite memories and documents it used. Provenance includes source, url, and timestamp.

documents.title: Generic ingest
documents.markdown: POST /ingest accepts externalId, title, markdown, and metadata. This is how Zapier scripts plug in.

documents.title: Manager
documents.markdown: Alex is the manager for the memory project. Luv reports to Alex on weekly progress.

documents.title: Chunking
documents.markdown: We decided on heading-aware chunks of about 500 tokens with 15 percent overlap. Unchanged chunks are never re-extracted.
